title: Elongated skulls without a sagittal suture from the Malta Hypogeum

tellings.quote: And inside the uh Maltese subterranean chamber of the Hypergemium, they actually found elongated skulls. One of them's on display in the Valleta Museum.

plain: Elongated skulls are said to have been found inside the Hypogeum of Malta, an ancient underground burial chamber cut into the rock, and one of them is said to be on display in a museum in Valletta, the island's capital. Jay Anderson, a researcher of ancient sites, tells this as something he has seen for himself. The story's point is that these skulls look unlike ordinary human ones, lacking the seam that normally runs along the top of the skull, which would hint at an unusual people in Malta's distant past.
